# Add only the new credential volume on upgrade. Never replace credentials or
# touch existing DB/files; Docker seeds its private ownership from the API image.
if ! docker volume inspect hwp-assistant-prod-codex-state >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  docker volume create --label app=hwp-assistant-prod hwp-assistant-prod-codex-state >/dev/null
fi
printf 'Next: verify login/editor/save over the real Funnel HTTPS URL. Codex device login and the configured owner must be verified separately.\n'

VOLUMES = ("hwp-assistant-prod-metadata", "hwp-assistant-prod-documents", "hwp-assistant-prod-codex-state")
        "LLM_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=60", "HWP_REWRITE_MAX_ACTIVE=1",
        "HWP_CODEX_USER=" + owner, "HWP_CODEX_ALLOWED_USERS=", "HWP_CODEX_MODEL=",
        "HWP_CODEX_DAILY_REQUEST_LIMIT=60", "HWP_REWRITE_PROVIDER=codex",
        "HWP_DOCUMENT_ASSISTANT_PROVIDER=codex", "HWP_ACCOUNTS_ENABLED=0",
        "HWP_REGISTRATION_ENABLED=0", "HWP_REGISTRATION_MAX_USERS=100", "HWP_GUEST_PASSWORD=", "",
    print(f"Created {path} (mode 600) and the three production volumes.")

self.assertEqual(text.count("external: true"), 3)
        self.assertIn('HWP_REWRITE_PROVIDER: ${HWP_REWRITE_PROVIDER:-codex}', text)
        self.assertIn('codex-state:/home/app/.codex', text)
        self.assertIn('HWP_CODEX_CHECK_AUTH: "1"', text)
